NODE
INT | Five-Minute Incident Check

PURPOSE
Polls only the bounded observability alert surface every five minutes.

CONTROL BOUNDARY
Trigger only; no notification destination or severity is supplied externally.

DOCUMENTATION STATUS
Incident notification adapter — 2026-09-29.

parameters.query: SELECT to_jsonb(p) AS alert FROM observability.get_pending_incident_notifications() p;

NODE
DB | Load Pending Incident Alerts

PURPOSE
Loads only alert-ready rows that pass governed severity, destination, cooldown and deduplication policy.

CONTROL BOUNDARY
Reporting RO calls a bounded SECURITY DEFINER function and cannot read raw failure/dead-letter tables.

DOCUMENTATION STATUS
Incident notification adapter — 2026-09-29.

REP | Build Incident Slack Payload

NODE
DEL | Send Incident Slack Alert

PURPOSE
Sends the governed incident to the trusted operational destination.

CONTROL BOUNDARY
Uses a dedicated incident credential separate from manager-report delivery. Final provider failure enters the reliability/dead-letter workflow.

DOCUMENTATION STATUS
Incident notification adapter — 2026-09-29.
